note: Size ceilings, not targets. A ceiling fails only on growth: the recorded value is the size at the last cut, and a smaller measurement passes and invites lowering the record. The hard caps are runtime limits read from the installed binaries by `harness_check.py --verify-runtime`; the ceilings under them are the harness's own margins, held as constants in hooks/harness_check.py and pinned here so the two cannot drift apart. The generated instruction file is measured from `tools/install-claude.py --render` with placeholder tree and commit, so the number does not move with a version string.
